title: KILL la KILL
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Transfer student Ryuuko Matoi arrives at Honnouji Academy with half of a giant scissor blade, hunting her father's killer. The school is ruled by student council president Satsuki Kiryuuin, whose power-granting 'Goku Uniforms' enforce a rigid ranking, and Ryuuko fights back with the living uniform Senketsu. A three-volume manga adaptation of the anime (MU; AniList; UK Anime Network review).
life_message: Stand up to a system that ranks and controls people, and fight for your friends and the truth.

content.note: Constant super-powered school battles and a revenge plot over a murdered father (MU Violence, Blood-Thirsty Protagonist, Dead Father; AniList Revenge; UK Anime review).

folkways.japan: Uses the Japanese school-uniform and student-council setting, where uniforms mark belonging and rank, as the target of its satire.

delivery.evidence: Theme carried by the plot of uniforms and ranking (UK Anime review); no review calls it preachy (to verify).
